name: Hanoi to Hue
summary: Fly if the date matters. Take the sleeper train if the journey is part of the trip. The bus is the budget overnight and the least comfortable of the three.

modes.duration: About 1 hour 20 minutes in the air
modes.note: Plus airport rides at both ends. The practical choice on a 14-day trip.
Reunification Express sleepers. Book a berth, not a hard seat.
Cheaper than the train berth and more tiring.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Hue — flight, train, or sleeper bus
seoDescription: How long Hanoi to Hue takes by air, rail, and bus, and which one to book on a short trip.

faqs.a: Fly if you have two weeks for the whole country. Take the train if you want the coast overnight and can spare the next morning.
